image.difference: Exact verified Base archive and pinned CPU donor; synthetic Git history replaces failed full-history fetch. Environment inputs unchanged. These are diagnostic-runtime runs, not a canonical-image rebuild.

e2e_boundary.pressure: Request -> real EngineCore/Scheduler/KV allocator -> connector-observed receive initiation -> legal completion input -> real client output, termination and later admission
e2e_boundary.nixl: Real local prefix and allocation lease -> production NIXL scheduler API -> real registration/loopback handshake/dispatch/completion collector -> EngineCore client output and cleanup
e2e_boundary.substitutions: Model token values and the external NIXL IO API are controlled producers. CPU buffers and vLLM connector/scheduler logic remain real. No private receive maps, parked statuses or future-version metadata fields are injected.
e2e_boundary.nixl_scope: Composed full-local-hit behavior and real downstream lifecycle. The frozen Base already handles the notify-only path; a later parked empty-receive state is not treated as naturally present here.

publication.scope: User-approved v1.7 task/reference/verifier hardening validated locally before updating the same PR #61 source branch. Canonical-image v1.7 CI and task publication remain separate. No new model capability trials.
publication.hash_note: Execution snapshots precede evidence-only writes; Harbor copies override only image tag and candidate solution patch. Each snapshot is identified separately.

Finite workloads cannot prove all possible lifetime bounds.
The local diagnostic runtime has exact Base source and fixed dependencies but synthetic Git history; canonical environment inputs are unchanged.
